title: Travel Guides
description: Plan, organize, and conduct long-distance travel, tours, and expeditions for individuals and groups.

tasks.text: Arrange for tour or expedition details such as accommodations, transportation, equipment, and the availability of medical personnel.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Arranging reservations and services via tools

dwas.name: Arrange services or reservations for patrons.

tasks.text: Plan tour itineraries, applying knowledge of travel routes and destination sites.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Event organizing aided; logistics and presence human

dwas.name: Organize recreational activities or events.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Resolve any problems with itineraries, service, or accommodations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Complaint resolution needs authority and rapport

dwas.name: Resolve customer complaints or problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Attend to special needs of tour participants.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on support for special-needs individuals
interpersonal — Closing sales requires persuasion and accountability

tasks.text: Evaluate services received on the tour, and report findings to tour organizers.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts reports to managers; human sends

dwas.name: Evaluate program effectiveness.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Report information to managers or other personnel.

tasks.text: Give advice on sightseeing and shopping.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Event info retrieval assisted; patron interaction human

dwas.name: Provide attraction or event information to patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Administer first aid to injured group participants.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Administering first aid requires physical intervention

tasks.text: Explain hunting and fishing laws to groups to ensure compliance.

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Lead individuals or groups to tour site locations and describe points of interest.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Event info retrieval assisted; patron interaction human

dwas.name: Provide attraction or event information to patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Pilot airplanes or drive land and water vehicles to transport tourists to activity or tour sites.

dwas.name: Drive vehicles to transport patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Sell or rent equipment, clothing, and supplies related to expeditions.

dwas.name: Monitor availability of equipment or supplies.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Demonstrating techniques is physical, hands-on work

dwas.name: Demonstrate activity techniques or equipment use.

tasks.text: Set up camps, and prepare meals for tour group members.
Provide tourists with assistance in obtaining permits and documents such as visas, passports, and health certificates, and in converting currency.
